dct_description_sm:
The City imposes these loans on the property as local improvement charges (LICs), applying a special lien on the property. This lien is binding on all future owners.  Visit Open Data Kingston to view the special charge bylaws for any completed project.
 
For more information about these special charges bylaws, contact cityclerk@cityofkingston.ca. Please include the property address and bylaw number in your request.
